hypothesis_test.claim: short numbered sentences fail while one long sentence succeeds at similar size
hypothesis_test.evidence: At matched chars: count 63 BPE -> 23.4s nano vs prose 48 BPE -> 15.1s. At ~30s tier: numbered 96 BPE -> 31.9s vs prose 74 BPE -> 24.2s.
